title: Decorated Pot UI
description: Displays the Item in Decorated Pots!
body:
# Decorated Pot UI

This Datapack displays the Item and its stack size in a "Decorated Pot" when hovering over it.

This also works with generated pots in the new Trial Chambers for example! However, you will need to right-click the pot once to generate its loot table first!


**Note:** Decorated Pots can store items starting in version **23w41a**, which is a Snapshot for Minecraft Version **1.20.3**

![A Decorated Pot with an Item- and Text-Display hovering over it, revealing that it contains 42 Diamonds!](https://i.imgur.com/dNSQKHA.png)
